_comment: Each scenario is a workload plus one candidate action. 'expectation' states the hypothesis the scenario was designed to test, not a result: what actually happens is what the harness measures.

S1_missing_index.description: The analytical tenant runs item lookups that scan its whole order_line partition.
S1_missing_index.expectation: benefits t_analytic; other tenants unaffected because the index is on t_analytic's partition only

S5_memory_role.description: Analytical sorts and hashes may spill to disk with the default sort memory.
S5_memory_role.expectation: benefits t_analytic if its queries spill; scoped to one tenant

S5_memory_instance.description: The same memory increase, applied to every connection of the instance.
S5_memory_instance.expectation: refused by static rules: worst-case memory exceeds the budget

S6_trap_index_all_tenants.description: The item index built for every tenant, so OLTP tenants pay to maintain it on every order line written.
S6_trap_index_all_tenants.expectation: benefits t_analytic; may tax OLTP tenants' writes

S7_trap_parallelism.description: More parallel workers per query, instance-wide, on a four-core instance shared with OLTP tenants.
S7_trap_parallelism.expectation: may speed analytical queries while taking CPU from OLTP tenants

S10_trap_parallelism_off.description: Parallel query switched off for the whole instance, to protect OLTP latency. The cost falls on the analytical tenants, whose scans lose their parallel workers.
S10_trap_parallelism_off.expectation: slows the analytical classes (the plan loses its workers); OLTP statements never use parallel plans, so no change expected for them. Nothing is claimed about any benefit

S7_parallelism_scoped.description: The same change limited to the analytical tenant's role.
S7_parallelism_scoped.expectation: same question as S7, narrower scope

S3_noisy_neighbour_cap.description: The bursty tenant's periodic bursts; a cap on its concurrent connections.
S3_noisy_neighbour_cap.expectation: protects other tenants during bursts at the cost of the bursty tenant's own latency

S9_no_change.description: Nothing is wrong; a harmless statistics refresh stands in for an action with no expected effect.
S9_no_change.expectation: no measurable effect; should not be approved as a benefit
